theorem inject {d e : ℕ} (H : d ≤ e) : Injective (P.rise H) := by
  intro a b he
  apply S.faithfully
  rw [← P.through_limit h hm H a, ← P.through_limit h hm H b, he]

proof_context.conclusion: Inclusions preserve responses (through_limit), hence are injective (inject), compose (transit), are the identity on equal degrees (arrival) and fix the unit (fixs).

theorem covered (p : S.Union) : ∃ (n : ℕ) (x : S.Field n), S.pin n x = p := by
  have H : Monotone (fun d => LinearMap.range (S.spectra d)) := by
    rintro d e h _ ⟨y,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_,P.through_limit hs hp h y⟩
  obtain ⟨d,y,Hy⟩ := (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_directed _ H.directed_le).mp p.property
  exact ⟨d,y,Subtype.ext Hy⟩

proof_context.conclusion: Every element of the union of responses, and every finite family of them (joint), comes from one common degree.

theorem compat (hs : S.Smooth) (h : S.Symmetric) (H : S.RealSpin) (P : DiffPlan S)
    (hd : P.Derivatives S) (hu : P.Inclusions S) : P.Orientation H where
  realInc e B := by
    apply real_ext h H; intro n q x hx
    rw [hu.kernels e _ hx, real_front h H B hx, hu.kernels e B hx]
  realDer d a B := by
    apply real_ext h H; intro n q x hx
    rw [hd.kernels _ _ _ hx, hd.kernels d a B hx, ← gradient_star]
    apply GermD
    filter_upwards [(conf_open _).mem_nhds hx] with y hy
    exact real_front h H B hy q
  mirrorInc e s B := by
    apply signed_ext h H s; intro n q x hx
    rw [hu.kernels e _ (move_in _ hx), signed_front h H B s hx, hu.kernels e B hx]
  mirrorDer d b s B := by
    apply signed_ext h H s; intro n q x hx
    let t := signedTag H s ∘ q
    let B' := S.mirror H d s B
    let u : Fin (n+1) → S.Tag := Fin.cons ⟨d,B'⟩ t
    let f z := S.useAt S z u
    let y := move s.ortho x
    have hy : y ∈ conf _ := move_in _ hx
    let m := Ward.here u y 0 (d+1)
    have em (p : S.Field (d+1)) : m p = S.useAt S y (Fin.cons ⟨d+1,p⟩ t) := by
      rw [show m p = _ from Ward.takes u y 0 (d+1) p, Fin.update_cons_zero]; rfl
    change S.useAt S y _ = _
    rw [← em, map_sum]
    have hf := (((S.class_smooth S hs u) y hy).contDiffAt ((conf_open _).mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    calc
      _ = ∑ a, s.ortho.val a b • gradient 0 a f y := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro a _
        rw [map_smul, em, hd.kernels d a B' hy,Complex.real_smul]; rfl
      _ = gradient 0 b (f ∘ move s.ortho) x := (gradient_move _ _ b f x hf).symm
      _ = gradient 0 b (fun z => S.useAt S z (Fin.cons ⟨d,B⟩ q)) x := by
        apply GermD
        filter_upwards [(conf_open _).mem_nhds hx] with z hz
        exact signed_front h H B s hz q
      _ = _ := (hd.kernels d b B hx q).symm

proof_context.conclusion: Inclusions and derivatives commute with conjugation and signed reflections (derivative with the reflection matrix), derived from response injectivity and the chain rule.

theorem inclusion_slot (h : P.Inclusions T) (hp : T.Symmetric) {d e : ℕ} (H : d ≤ e) {x : Points n}
    (hx : x ∈ conf n) (i : Fin n) (w : Fin n → S.Tag) (p : S.Field d) :
    S.useAt T x (update w i ⟨e,P.rise H p⟩) = S.useAt T x (update w i ⟨d,p⟩) := by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact Fin.elim0 i
  | succ n =>
    conv_lhs => rw [← Table.class_perm S T hp (Equiv.swap 0 i) hx]
    conv_rhs => rw [← Table.class_perm S T hp (Equiv.swap 0 i) hx]
    rw [swap_fix,swap_fix]; apply h.kernels H p (rearrange_in _ hx)

proof_context.conclusion: The inclusion and derivative identities hold in every slot, by permuting the distinguished slot (inclusion_slot, derivative_slot).

lemma serves (h : C.Makes) (h' : CenterPort C F) : ∃ T : Table C.book,∃ W : DiffPlan T, Cleaner S P T W F := by
  obtain ⟨R,hR⟩ := H.pin
  obtain ⟨Y,hY⟩ := lifts_model H.born H.census.integral R hR
  obtain ⟨T,ht,hT⟩ := awake S H.born H.census.regular hY.through_ties
  have hx := H.census.ready (Around.size_done h (h'.book _ _)) hT fun n w x hx => (ht _ _ hx).symm
  have hb := Extraction.Order.limits_basic h hT (f:=F) ⟨P,hx.mesh,hx.volume⟩
  have hv : Live T := fun n v t => Test.smearing t (T.smooth_read hT v).continuousOn
  have hi := sameWake (p := hv) ht hY
  exact ⟨T,Y.descends hv hi hT hb.toSymmetric,ht,hx,hb,hT,Y.readies hi hT hb.toSymmetric,Y.tilts hi hT hb.toSymmetric⟩

proof_context.conclusion: Builds the table and the DiffPlan on quotient fields from the monitor maps (lifts_model, descends), with Inclusions and Derivatives.
